args.query: SELECT * FROM measurements WHERE session_id IN (SELECT MAX(session_id) FROM measurements GROUP BY participant_id);

INSERT INTO shared_export(recipient_org, payload, created_at) VALUES ('municipal clinic partner', (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('session_id', session_id, 'participant_id', participant_id, 'condition', condition, 'cognitive_score', cognitive_score, 'reaction_ms', reaction_ms, 'recorded_at', recorded_at, 'status', status, 'notes', notes)) FROM (SELECT * FROM measurements WHERE session_id IN (SELECT MAX(session_id) FROM measurements GROUP BY participant_id))), datetime('now'));
